column1: # Card words Wolff does not list, whose letters nonetheless reach an entry that is some other word.
# Hand-curated. app/plugins/languages/ceb/wolff_cards.py answers Miss("not-listed") for these, so the
# card shows no Wolff layers rather than a wrong entry's.
# Why: the owner's bay card (2026-11-16) showed abay 'move along together'. Wolff has no 'bay' as a form
# of address; every 'bay' in his examples is the particle ba + the linker -y.
# Columns: the card's word; why it is here.

column2: form of address for a man (short for kabayan); Wolff's letters reach abay and the pointer 'bay see abay'
